translations.web: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
translations.bsb: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
translations.kjv: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
translations.asv: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth in front of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
